impact.title: This delete reaches other tables
impact.description: Saving these changes will also touch rows that reference the rows you delete.
impact.set_null_one: Sets the reference to NULL in {{n}} row of {{table}}
impact.set_null_other: Sets the reference to NULL in {{n}} rows of {{table}}
impact.set_default_one: Resets the reference to its default in {{n}} row of {{table}}
impact.set_default_other: Resets the reference to its default in {{n}} rows of {{table}}
impact.noUndo: You won't be able to undo this save.

tableActions.truncateDescription: Every row is deleted at once (TRUNCATE). This cannot be undone.
tableActions.dropDescription: The table and all its data are deleted (DROP TABLE). This cannot be undone.
tableActions.truncateCascade: Also empty the tables that reference it (CASCADE)
tableActions.dropCascade: Also delete what depends on it (CASCADE)
tableActions.truncateNeedsCascade: Without CASCADE, Postgres will refuse while those tables reference it.
tableActions.dropNeedsCascade: Without CASCADE, Postgres will refuse while those objects depend on it.

fk.description: The row this value points to.
fk.missing: The referenced row no longer exists.

connections.title: Connections
connections.name: Name
connections.keepPassword: Leave empty to keep the current one
connections.locked: Defined by DATABASE_URL: it can only be changed in the environment.

structureEdit.dropColumnDescription: The column and all its values are deleted (DROP COLUMN). This cannot be undone.
structureEdit.using: Convert the existing values with a cast (USING column::new_type)
structureEdit.incomplete: Fill in the form to see the SQL.

warning.rewrite: Rewrites the whole table and its indexes: it can take a while on big tables.
warning.lock: Locks the table (ACCESS EXCLUSIVE) while it runs: reads and writes wait.
warning.scan: Reads every row of the table: it can take a while on big tables.
warning.existing_data: Can fail because of the rows already in the table; if it does, nothing changes.
warning.blocks_writes: Blocks writes to the table while it runs (reads go on).
warning.no_transaction: Runs outside a transaction: writes go on, but if it fails it leaves an invalid index you have to delete.

structureEdit.expressionHint: An SQL condition, run exactly as written: check it in the SQL below.
structureEdit.notValid: Don't check existing rows now (NOT VALID)
structureEdit.drop_indexDescription: The index is deleted (DROP INDEX). Queries that used it can get slower.
structureEdit.drop_constraintDescription: The constraint is deleted (DROP CONSTRAINT): its rule no longer applies to new rows.

pgError.23502: Some existing rows have NULL where a value is required.
pgError.23503: Some existing rows don't match the foreign key. Fix them first, or create it as NOT VALID and validate it later.
pgError.23505: Some existing rows repeat values that would have to be unique. Remove the duplicates first.
pgError.23514: Some existing rows don't meet the condition. Fix them first, or create it as NOT VALID and validate it later.

dataLoss.not_writable: The data directory is not writable: saved queries and settings live in memory and are lost on every restart.
dataLoss.tmpfs: The data directory is in memory (tmpfs): saved queries and settings are lost on every restart.
dataLoss.anonymous_volume: The data directory is an anonymous volume: saved queries and settings are lost when the container is removed.
dataLoss.container_layer: The data directory is inside the container: saved queries and settings are lost when the container is removed.
dataLoss.fix: Mount a named volume on /data (GRESBASE_DATA_DIR) to keep them.
